role: Read-only 01/05/09 oil curve with four listed contracts, half-month cutoffs, globally scaled weekly futures volume and open interest, complete histories, and reserved standard-futures specifications.

volume_lots.note: Weekly futures turnover allocated across the four listed contracts; higher periods sum visible weeks.

open_interest_change_lots.note: Change from the same contract's prior visible week.

reference.monthly.note: Visible spot OHLC aggregated from two half-month turns; no futures liquidity fields are added to spot.

mainContinuous.monthly.note: Visible backward-ratio-adjusted main OHLC; volume and open interest come from the active source contract and are never price-adjusted.

curve.contracts[].monthly.note: Named OIL-YYMM price, weekly volume, and end-week open-interest history from listing through cutoff or expiry.

invariants: exactly four 01/05/09 delivery-month contracts are listed
one standard lot represents 1000 barrels and one minimum tick is 10 USD per lot
one month contains two game turns and no week beyond the half-month cutoff is published
each named contract has at most 16 months and 32 half-month turns
weekly contract volumes sum to the published global futures-market weekly volume
weekly contract open interests sum to the published global futures-market open interest
liquidity migrates from the old main contract toward the next contract around a roll
the spot-reference history receives no volume or open-interest fields
the main series is backward-ratio-adjusted while its liquidity fields are unadjusted source-contract observations
long-run liquidity is bounded and does not use a fixed compounding growth rate
no future weekly close or later annual macro state is used at a cutoff
no player, order, position, or portfolio state is a pricing or liquidity input
no write-back to global macro or commodity overlay
